title: What's New: Post Emissions with the General Journal (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Requirements and limitations for general journal emissions
Live demonstration of general journal emissions posting

features.name: Post emissions through general journal
features.description: Users can now post sustainability emissions values directly through general journal entries, alongside regular financial amounts. Previously emissions could only be posted through sustainability journal or purchase documents.
caveats: Only supported with document types: invoice, credit memo, or blank
Cannot be used with payment document types
Financial amount must be present - cannot post only emissions without ledger amount
Cannot use formulas for emission calculation in general journal
Only greenhouse gas emissions supported, not water and waste

features.name: Greenhouse gas emissions selection in general journal
features.description: Users can select and post three types of greenhouse gas emissions in general journal: carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrogen dioxide as total values.
caveats: Only greenhouse gas emissions supported in general journal, not water and waste
Posted as total values only, not calculated via formulas

features.name: Sustainability account selection with defaults
features.description: GL accounts can have default sustainability accounts configured. When posting in general journal, users can select sustainability accounts and modify them if needed.

features.name: Validation for sustainability posting in general journal
features.description: System validates that journal lines can only have sustainability accounts when using allowed document types (invoice, credit memo, blank). Payment lines cannot post emissions.
caveats: Payment document type is explicitly not allowed

features.name: Water and waste management in sustainability journal
features.description: Sustainability journal supports posting water and waste management data in addition to greenhouse gas emissions, a capability not available in general journal or purchase documents.
caveats: Only available in sustainability journal, not in general journal or purchase documents

features.name: Emission formulas in sustainability journal
features.description: Sustainability journal allows using embedded formulas to calculate total emissions from different sources, providing more flexibility than direct value posting.
caveats: Not available in general journal or purchase documents
